_doc: lab.collect.dexscreener settings. chains: DexScreener chain ids, Solana only by default; add base, ethereum, bsc to collect them too (or set PYTHIA_DEXSCREENER_CHAINS=solana,base). search: per chain, words whose search results (30 pairs a query) add pairs younger than new_pair_max_age_h; four a run, in turn. retention_days 0 keeps the snapshots forever; budget_gb deletes whole snapshot days, oldest first, over it.
